angorarabbit: A scientific field-guide illustration of an Angora rabbit in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet. Natural rabbit proportions beneath the coat: a long body, upright ears, a small dark eye set on the side of the head. Its body, face, ears and legs are all covered in LONG SILKY PURE WHITE WOOL hanging in loose locks past its feet, so the outline is soft and shaggy. Long white tufts trail from each ear tip.
beardeddragon: A scientific field-guide illustration of a bearded dragon in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing flat on all four legs. Natural lizard proportions: a broad flattened body, a wide triangular head, short splayed legs, a tail as long as the body. Small round eye set flat in the side of the head. The loose skin beneath the jaw is puffed into a rounded pouch whose scales are enlarged into SHORT DARK POINTED SPINES. Rows of pointed scales edge each flank. Sandy tan.
beardedseal: A scientific field-guide illustration of a bearded seal in STRICT SIDE PROFILE lying flat on its belly. Natural proportions: a very thick heavy body with a SMALL HEAD, short front flippers flat against the sides, hind flippers trailing straight back. Small dark eye set flat in the face. From the sides of its muzzle spring ABOUT TWENTY LONG SEPARATE PALE WHISKERS curling loosely at the ends. Plain silvery-grey.
bluemussel: A scientific field-guide illustration of a single blue mussel shell seen from the side at a slight angle so it reads as a solid three-dimensional object. Its outline is asymmetric: NARROW AND POINTED at the hinge end, BROADLY FANNED and rounded at the other, with a curved upper edge and a straighter lower edge. Deep dull blue-black, matte, with fine concentric growth lines. A small tuft of fine golden-brown threads emerges at the pointed end.
bredaxolotl: A scientific field-guide illustration of a leucistic axolotl in STRICT SIDE PROFILE. Natural proportions: a LONG LOW SALAMANDER BODY several times longer than it is deep, a broad flat head no deeper than the body, four small slender legs, and a long tail with a low fin above and below. SMALL DARK LIDLESS EYES set flat on the side of the head. Three pairs of slender gill stalks fringed with red filaments project sideways behind the head. Smooth pinkish-white skin.
brownrat: A scientific field-guide illustration of a brown rat in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet. Natural wild proportions: a long low body, a blunt heavy muzzle, small thick rounded ears, coarse grizzled brown fur lying flat. SMALL DARK EYE set flat in the side of the head. Its tail is a thick scaly rope, wide at the base and tapering, about as long as its head and body together, trailing straight out behind.
englishbudgie: A scientific field-guide illustration of an English show budgerigar in STRICT SIDE PROFILE. Natural bird proportions: a deep broad chest, a long tapering tail. The feathers of its forehead and crown are LONG AND DENSE AND LIE SMOOTHLY BACKWARD OVER THE SKULL as part of the plumage, swelling the head into a high rounded dome that slightly overhangs the eye - a smooth mass, never a raised crest and never a swept quiff. Sky-blue body, white face, fine black wing barring.
europeanmole: A scientific field-guide illustration of a European mole in STRICT SIDE PROFILE, LOW AND HORIZONTAL with its belly near the ground. Natural proportions: a smooth cylindrical body of dense black velvet fur with no neck and no waist, tapering into a SHORT CONICAL PINK SNOUT. Its enormous pink spade-shaped front paws sit at ground level beside the head, turned outward. Eye invisible in the fur, tiny hind feet, a short pink stub of tail.
fancypigeon: A scientific field-guide illustration of a white fantail pigeon in STRICT SIDE PROFILE. Natural pigeon proportions: a small rounded body, a short bill, short feathered legs, the chest carried high and the head tipped back. Its tail is spread into a BROAD ROUNDED FAN HELD VERTICALLY behind the body, made of many short stiff feathers of even length forming a smooth semicircular disc. Entirely pure white.
frenchbulldog: A scientific field-guide illustration of a French bulldog in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet. Natural proportions: a small compact heavy body, a deep broad chest, short thick straight legs, a short stumpy tail. Its head is large and square with a very short flat muzzle and a deep nose wrinkle. Its ears are LARGE, UPRIGHT, BROAD AT THE BASE AND ROUNDED ACROSS THE TOP. Short smooth fawn coat, small dark eye set flat.
hornbill: A scientific field-guide illustration of a southern ground hornbill in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on the ground on long dark legs. Natural proportions: a large heavy-bodied bird the size of a turkey, entirely sooty black, with a long stout neck. BARE WRINKLED SCARLET-RED SKIN covers its face and throat, forming a mask around the pale eye and a loose folded wattle under the chin. Its bill is heavy, black and gently downcurved with a low casque ridge along the top.
littlemarianafruitbat: A scientific field-guide illustration of a little Marianas fruit bat in STRICT SIDE PROFILE hanging upright with its wings folded closed along its flanks. Natural proportions: a slender body, long thin folded forearms, and a HEAD SHAPED LIKE A SMALL FOX'S - a long tapering muzzle, a black nose at the tip, a small dark eye set on the side, small simple pointed ears. Dark chocolate fur with a pale golden mantle over the shoulders.
loggerheadturtle: A scientific field-guide illustration of a loggerhead sea turtle in STRICT SIDE PROFILE swimming level. Natural proportions: a LOW FLAT STREAMLINED SHELL, broad and only slightly domed, and LONG FLAT PADDLE-SHAPED FRONT FLIPPERS held out like wings, much longer than the rear pair and carrying no toes. Its head is large and blocky with a heavy hooked beak and the mouth closed. Small dark eye set flat. Reddish-brown shell, yellow-brown scaled skin.
mountaingoat: A scientific field-guide illustration of a mountain goat in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet. Natural proportions: a heavy thickset body, a deep chest, a pronounced hump over the shoulders, a SHORT THICK NECK and short sturdy legs. Thick shaggy white coat with long chaps over the legs and a white beard under the chin. Its horns are SHORT, SLENDER, SMOOTH AND JET BLACK, no longer than its own ears, curving only slightly backward. Black hooves and nose.
mutt: A scientific field-guide illustration of a mixed-breed dog of no recognisable breed, in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet. Natural proportions: a plain medium dog of moderate build, a medium-length tapered muzzle, one ear flopping and the other half standing, and a short coarse coat in an uneven muddy mix of tan and grey-brown with a few asymmetric off-white patches. A shelter mongrel, absolutely NOT a hound, NOT a collie and NOT any pedigree breed.
pistolshrimp: A scientific field-guide illustration of a pistol shrimp in STRICT SIDE PROFILE. Natural proportions: a small slender SHRIMP with a smooth curved back, a thin fan tail, long fine antennae and small stalked eyes - never a lobster and never heavy-shelled. ONE CLAW IS ENLARGED TO ABOUT THE SIZE OF THE SHRIMP'S OWN BODY, blocky and squared with a thick pivoting hammer, held forward. THE OTHER CLAW IS TINY. Semi-transparent, banded orange and white.
plainspocketgopher: A scientific field-guide illustration of a plains pocket gopher in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet. Natural proportions: a stout low cylindrical rodent with a broad flat head, tiny ears, a small dark eye set flat, a short sparsely haired tail. Its two upper front teeth are SHORT BROAD ORANGE CHISELS growing from the upper jaw and just showing beyond the lips, no longer than the depth of its own muzzle. Heavy pale digging claws, brown fur.
woollyflyingsquirrel: A scientific field-guide illustration of a woolly flying squirrel in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on all four feet, the gliding membrane hanging as a LOOSE SLACK FOLD OF FURRED SKIN along each flank between wrist and ankle, covered in the same dense woolly grey-brown fur as the body, never bare and never leathery. Natural proportions: a large squirrel the size of a domestic cat, small rounded ears, a small dark eye, a long thick heavily furred tail.
xmasislandpipistrelle: A scientific field-guide illustration of a Christmas Island pipistrelle in STRICT SIDE PROFILE hanging upright with its wings folded closed along its flanks. Natural proportions: a tiny slender bat with a body no longer than a thumb, a narrow chest, long thin folded forearms, a short blunt muzzle and small rounded ears. SMALL BLACK EYES, correctly tiny. Dense soft dark chocolate-brown fur, thin dark leathery wing membrane.
bumblebeebat: A scientific field-guide illustration of a bumblebee bat in STRICT SIDE PROFILE hanging upright with its wings folded closed. Natural proportions: an extremely small slender bat, its body no longer than a thumb joint, with a narrow chest and long thin folded forearms. SMALL BLACK EYES, correctly tiny. Its ears are large, upright and rounded, and its muzzle is short and blunt. Fine reddish-brown fur, thin dark wing membrane.
hoodedseal: A scientific field-guide illustration of a hooded seal in STRICT SIDE PROFILE lying flat. Natural proportions: a heavy silver-grey seal blotched with irregular black patches, its head small relative to the thick body, small dark eye set flat. A SMOOTH RED SAC OF NASAL LINING PROTRUDES FROM ONE NOSTRIL AT THE VERY TIP OF THE MUZZLE, hanging forward and downward in front of the mouth, about the size of the animal's own snout and no larger.
portuguesemanowar: A scientific illustration of a Portuguese man o' war seen from the side. Its float is a NARROW ELONGATED HORIZONTAL POD lying flat along its long axis, at least three times longer than it is tall, tapering to a point at both ends like a slim canoe - never domed, never bell-shaped, never rounded on top. A thin ruffled crest runs along the upper ridge. Translucent pale blue shading to rose. Fine bright blue tentacles of unequal length trail down from beneath one end.
remora: A scientific field-guide illustration of a remora in STRICT SIDE PROFILE. Natural proportions: a slim streamlined dark grey fish with a small forked tail and a lower jaw jutting past the upper. On top of its head, FLUSH WITH THE SKULL AND EXACTLY THE WIDTH AND LENGTH OF THE HEAD ITSELF, lies a shallow oval plate finely ridged across with parallel lines. It lies flat within the head outline and never rises above it or reaches past the eyes.
americancurl: A scientific field-guide illustration of an American curl cat seen FROM BEHIND AND SLIGHTLY ABOVE, its head turned so both ears show clearly in silhouette against the skull. EACH EAR ARCHES BACKWARD IN A SMOOTH FIRM CURVE SO THAT ITS TIP POINTS BACK TOWARD THE CAT'S OWN TAIL, the opening facing upward and forward, the whole ear bending over like a rolled petal. Natural cat proportions, silky medium coat, a plumed tail.
chinstrappenguin: A scientific field-guide illustration of a chinstrap penguin in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing upright. Natural proportions: a medium penguin with a white face and throat and a neat black cap over the crown. A SINGLE FINE BLACK LINE RUNS HORIZONTALLY ACROSS THE UNDERSIDE OF THE CHIN from one side of the head to the other, passing beneath the beak, so in profile it reads as a short black bar under the jaw. Black back and flippers, small black bill, pink feet.
colossalsquid: A scientific field-guide illustration of a colossal squid. Natural proportions: a SHORT WIDE HEAVY REDDISH MANTLE, broad and blunt rather than long and pointed, with two large triangular fins. ITS EYE IS AN ENORMOUS DARK GLOBE filling nearly the whole side of the head and wider than the base of its arms - the largest eye of any animal. Eight thick powerful arms and two longer tentacles carry rows of sharp curved swivelling hooks.
himalayanmonal: A scientific field-guide illustration of a Himalayan monal cock in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing on the ground. Natural pheasant proportions: a stocky body, short legs, and a SHORT SQUARE RUST-ORANGE TAIL no longer than its own body. Metallic iridescent plumage: emerald head, coppery-violet nape, blue-green back, a white patch on the lower back. From the crown rises a NARROW UPRIGHT TUFT OF ABOUT TWENTY FINE BARE WIRES held close together, no taller than the head - never a spread fan and never a train.
rossgull: A scientific field-guide illustration of a Ross's gull in STRICT SIDE PROFILE standing. Natural proportions: a small delicate gull with a slim body, a rounded head, a VERY SMALL BLACK BILL and short bright red legs, its tail wedge-shaped and pointed in the middle. Pale pearl-grey back and wings, white head. A SOFT ROSE-PINK WASH tints the breast and belly. A NARROW COMPLETE BLACK LINE encircles the neck like a fine thread, thin and sharply defined.
